title: INSTRUMENT PANEL WIRING HARNESS
summary: Routing of the instrument panel wiring harness (dash harness) behind the tach and speedometer, with the gauge bulbs (cluster illumination, high-beam 'bright' indicator, LH/RH turn indicators, 'park' alarm) and the courtesy lamp bulb, and its branches to the fuse panel, ignition switch, back-up lamp switch, stop lamp switch, clutch safety switch, dir. signal connector, W/S wiper override switch, body harness connector and LH door jamb switch. The harness is held with clips; a rivet goes into a 13/64 dia. hole under the panel.

fastening.note: Clips [6] hold the harness [1]: one at the upper harness bundle behind the tachometer, one push-in clip into a hole in the panel ahead of the 2.00 dimension.
Rivet [5] goes up into a 13/64 dia. hole under the panel (dimensioned 2.00 and 1.00 from the clip hole/edge) to retain the harness.
Bulbs [2] twist into harness sockets in the gauge backs: A cluster illumination, B 'bright' indicator, C L.H. direction indicator, D 'park' alarm, E R.H. direction indicator.

fastening.to: courtesy lamp socket on harness, right side
fastening.note: Courtesy lamp bulb [3] plugs into the harness lamp socket at the right of the speedometer.

notes: NOTE: Route over air duct thru rear rect pillar hole, down thru pillar to SW.
A Cluster Illumination; B "Bright" Indicator; C L.H. Direction Indicator; D "Park" Alarm; E R.H. Direction Indicator.

Branches: TACH GROUND, TO BACK-UP LAMP SW, TO IGN SW., TO RADIO CAPACITOR, TO STOP LAMP SW., TO DIR. SIG. CONNECTOR, TO CLUTCH SAFETY SW, TO W/S WIPER OVERIDE SWITCH, TO BODY WIRING HARN. CONN., SPEEDOMETER GROUND, FUSE PANEL, TO GROUND SCREW, TO L.H. DOOR JAMB SWITCH. Also GROMMET (UPC-12), RIVET (UPC5), BRAKE PEDAL HOUSING COVER.
